messages.subject: Project Harbor - proposed negotiating position on SPA
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Ahead of our counter to Castle & Vane, proposed landing zone on the open points:
- Liability cap: target 20% of Initial Consideration (£7.58m) - down from our 100% opener, they're at 25%.
- De minimis £45k / basket £500k.
- General warranty period 18 months (conceded); tax covenant held at 7 years.
- Non-compete back to 3 years (Geoffrey is staying on).
- Earn-out threshold £5.4m EBITDA, max £4m, cap reached at £6.4m.

Comfortable?

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
